known_gaps: Selectors are proxies; the criterion text is authoritative where they differ.

The class totals are graded in the register and on the slide only (V3: no fact in three or more rows); the same totals in the ZOM-801 description and the hub reply are covered by that fact, not by separate rows.
printed_total reads the first READY/WATCH/HOLD number outside the component rows; a totals block in another layout needs manual reading.
tracker_entry checks both values on the key's line under Value notes; values on a following line pass the criterion but fail the selector.
register_parent follows gdrive_create_file parentId and gdrive_move_file; a register moved by another tool is read manually.
group_size counts distinct keys under a heading the parser recognises; unusual headings need manual reading.
Class rows grade the class only; register field representation for owner-called components is not graded.

Unsampled class rows are covered by the volume rows (row count and class totals), per rubric_sampling.md; edges not sampled here (eligibility, epoch, remap, billing history) are protected by direct rows (M4 claim, Control-tab remap, M3 calls).
